name: Quantile Interpolation for Uncertain Data
definition: A method to compute the interpolated Probability Density Function (PDF) of a random variable X at an arbitrary 3D position by interpolating quantile representations from the eight vertices of the containing 3D cell.
summary: Quantile Interpolation efficiently computes uncertainty distributions in volume rendering by interpolating nonparametric probability distributions with linear time complexity, preserving distribution modality unlike traditional convolution-based methods.
